scenes.title: Leads, follow-ups and tasks
scenes.subtitle: From the first enquiry to the booking
scenes.narration: Every trip starts as an enquiry. Here is how TravelCRM Pro keeps each one moving, from the first message to the booking.
All your leads in one list. Filter by stage, owner or source, and search by name or destination. New rows load as you scroll.
Adding a lead takes a minute. Pick the customer from a searchable list, add destinations, dates, travellers and budget, and save.
The lead page holds everything: trip details, the activity timeline, notes, follow-ups, itineraries, invoices and documents.
Move a lead through the stages as it progresses. If a trip does not book, mark it lost and note why, so your reports show where deals slip.
New leads nobody owns yet wait in Unassigned. A manager picks a teammate and assigns them, one at a time or in bulk.
Or let rules do it. Round-robin assignment, routing by source, and follow-up sequences that plan the next touches for every new lead.
Follow-ups show what is due today and what is overdue. Complete one with an outcome, or schedule the next call in a few clicks.
Tasks carry an owner, a due date and a link to the lead, and an overdue task alerts its owner. Switch to the board, open one, comment and move it along.
The calendar puts meetings, arrivals and follow-ups side by side. Add an event straight from the week view.
Bring leads in from a spreadsheet, and export the list whenever you need it.

scenes.headline: No enquiry left behind.
